subject.title: feat(queue): persist followup queues across gateway restarts

question: Should restored followup queues be guaranteed to resume immediately after gateway startup, or is waiting for a later inbound turn an acceptable product contract?
rationale: The branch claims post-restart delivery but currently relies on a wake path that does not visibly schedule the restored drain; choosing the permanent recovery contract determines the appropriate owner boundary and validation.

options.title: Guarantee startup recovery
options.body: Require a startup-safe continuation that schedules each restored route through the normal drain pipeline once its callback is available.

options.title: Document deferred recovery
options.body: Accept delivery only after a later inbound turn and narrow the feature claim, user messaging, and tests to that weaker contract.

options.title: Pause for queue API design
options.body: Defer this persistence layer until a shared followup-resume API defines the callback and restart lifecycle cleanly.

recommendation.title: Guarantee startup recovery
recommendation.body: Require a startup-safe continuation that schedules each restored route through the normal drain pipeline once its callback is available.
